Based on visual observation, fully developed

of 32 C compared to only 10 C for the CNT-coated surface.
The bare silicon substrates were formed by dicing the wafer into 12.7 mm 12.7 mm square chips using a Tempress 602 dicing saw.
A copper chip was machined to the same size of the aforementioned silicon chips.
